caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid, shown front-on. The chest is mostly brown, with a lighter brown, wood-textured top. The front face of the chest features an ornate, symmetrical, folk-art design. This design is centered around a stylized, large black plant with an upward-sprouting central stalk topped with red, cream, and black leaves, resembling a flower or feather. This central motif is flanked on each side by swirling black and red vines with more cream, red, and black leaves extending outward in symmetrical patterns. The bottom center of the chest displays a rounded, vase-like shape in red with a checkered pattern. The front border of the chest is outlined in a dark, nearly black color. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the name “ISABELLA RUTH DOERFLER” is typed in red capital letters. The background of the drawing is an off-white or beige paper.
title: Guilford Blanket Chest
